Coal prices remain supported by Asian energy security needs, benefiting low-cost producers like ANTM and TINS.
Government policy favoring local processing and export bans on raw ores creates durable competitive advantages for integrated miners.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

themes: Rising middle-class consumption in Indonesia drives premiumization in packaged foods and personal care, benefiting ICBP and UNVR.
Government policies supporting domestic manufacturing and raw material self-sufficiency reduce input cost volatility for MYOR and CPIN.
Tobacco stocks GGRM and HMSP gain from stable pricing power and high dividends, appealing in a low-rate environment.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
sectors.ai: Indonesia's infrastructure sector shows strong local outperformance (+1.81% vs +1.04% US), driven by TOWR's +13.37% surge likely on tower monetization or regulatory clarity. Watch for sustained momentum in digital infrastructure (TLKM, TOWR) and toll roads (JSMR) as government capex accelerates ahead of 2024 elections.

sectors.name: Healthcare

themes: Government's JKN universal health coverage expansion is structurally boosting inpatient volumes and hospital revenue growth for operators like MIKA and OMED.
Rising middle-class spending on preventive care and OTC drugs creates durable demand for consumer health names like SIDO and DVLA.
Domestic vaccine production and pharmaceutical localization policies provide a multi-year growth runway for MERK and PEHA, reducing import dependency.

sectors.name: Logistics
sectors.ai: Indonesia logistics outperformed US peers today, led by KPIG and SMDR, signaling domestic demand resilience. Watch for sustained volume growth from e-commerce and mining exports; consider adding on pullbacks given the sector's structural tailwinds and current valuation support.
themes: E-commerce penetration in Indonesia continues to accelerate, driving durable demand for last-mile delivery and warehousing services from players like BIRD and ASSA.
Government infrastructure spending under the new capital city (IKN) and toll road expansion is structurally lowering logistics costs and boosting throughput for land and sea operators.
Commodity export volumes, particularly coal and nickel, remain robust, providing a steady revenue base for shipping and port companies like SMDR and IPCM despite global trade headwinds.
